overview: Saint Kitts and Nevis is the smallest country in the Americas, made up of two islands in the eastern Caribbean. Its capital, Basseterre, is on Saint Kitts. It became independent from the United Kingdom in 1983. The country is a federation, and Nevis has its own island government.

geography.text: Both islands are volcanic, with rainforest-covered mountains in the centre; Mount Liamuiga on Saint Kitts is the highest point. The two islands are separated by a channel only about three kilometres wide, called The Narrows.
